titel: Doctor Dolittle in the Moon by Hugh Lofting ~ Full Audiobook [children]

einzeiler: Doctor Dolittle and his companions travel to the moon on a giant moth's back.
kurzfassung: Thomas Stubbins accompanies Doctor Dolittle and animal friends on a perilous voyage to the moon, where they encounter giant insects, talking plants, and a prehistoric human. After extensive botanical and linguistic studies, Tommy is reluctantly sent back to Earth, where he deals with his gigantic new size. The group in Puddleby eagerly awaits the doctor's eventual return.
stichpunkte: Journey to the moon on the back of a giant moth named Jamiro Bumble-Lily
Adaptation to the moon's low gravity, strange air, and shifting colors
Exploration of a peaceful lunar world dominated by plant life and a governing council
Discovery of singing trees, vanity lilies, and explosive wood used for signaling
Meeting the Moon Man, identified as prehistoric artist Otho Bulge
Providing medical treatment to ailing giant insects and animals on the moon
Tommy's kidnapping and return to Earth, arriving as a giant on Salisbury Plain
Working briefly in a circus before returning to Puddleby to care for the doctor's home

kapitel.titel: The Land of Colors and Perfumes
On the Plateau and the Moon Lake
Tracks of a Giant and the Singing Trees
Plant Languages and the Magellan of the Moon
The Flower of Many Scents and Mirrors

clips.hook: Mental capacity resembles dairy spread when stretched too thin.
clips.text: Human focus has strict limits and cannot retain information when distributed across too many simultaneous impressions.

clips.hook: Slight movements from the ankles launch travelers into fantastic flights.
clips.text: Lunar gravity creates an extraordinary jumping sensation where minimal effort sends individuals soaring dramatically upward.

clips.hook: The evolutionary tale explains how primates lost or kept their tails.
clips.text: Evolution tracks the process by which humans discarded unnecessary appendages while other animals retained them.

clips.hook: An ordinary human nostril easily detects half a dozen distinct odors.
clips.text: Standard human smell detection is sensitive enough to identify numerous simultaneous scents produced by a specific flower.

clips.hook: A local farm laborer bolted like a rabbit into the heavy mist.
clips.text: A rural worker became terrified and fled immediately upon encountering an unexpected gigantic figure in the fog.

beschreibung:
You've seen the Eddie Murphy movies, but you haven't seen anything yet! Prepare for a blockbuster-level audio adventure that goes far beyond any movie adaptation. The beloved, animal-communicating Doctor Dolittle is back in his grandest adventure ever, and this time, the stakes are cosmic.

In this epic audiobook, Hugh Lofting’s classic tale takes our hero and his animal crew out of the jungle and into uncharted territory—the moon! Forget special effects; let your mind create the scenery as the doctor travels through space on the back of a giant moth. When he arrives, he finds not a barren rock, but a lush, mysterious lunar landscape.
Just like a Hollywood summer flick, there’s high adventure, suspense, and incredible new life forms. The good doctor must communicate with sentient, talking plants to learn the moon's secrets and find its one human inhabitant. It’s a race against time, with the ultimate question: will they ever make it back to Earth? This is the ultimate cinematic tale for your ears, a wilder ride than any movie could capture. Get your headphones and prepare for an audio journey that's pure, blockbuster entertainment.
